output.title: New ingress-shim option; no sign this environment uses or sets it
output.content: The release notes add a new ingress-shim option, `--extra-certificate-annotations`, which copies listed annotation keys from Ingress-like objects to the Certificate objects created from them. This environment runs cert-manager v1.17.0 and has cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests. However, none of the manifest apiVersions shown is an Ingress or Gateway resource, and none of the values keys set (for example replicaCount, webhook.timeoutSeconds, prometheus.servicemonitor.enabled) configures ingress-shim or controller arguments. The excerpt also doesn't say what happens when the option is left unset, so to settle this you need to check whether any Ingress-like resources in the cluster have cert-manager create Certificates for them, and decide whether you want this option.
